mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.title, t.board_column, t.progress, t.completed_at, t.due_date, t.start_date, t.estimate_minutes, t.item_type AS itemType, t.owner, t.owner_user_id, vt.version_id, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tl.minutes), 0) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.ended_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_minutes FROM task t LEFT JOIN version_task vt ON vt.task_id = t.id AND vt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.req_id = #{reqId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY (t.board_column = 'done'), t.board_column, t.sort_order, t.id

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.board_column, t.progress, t.completed_at, t.due_date, t.start_date, t.estimate_minutes, t.item_type AS itemType, t.owner, t.owner_user_id, vt.version_id, t.branch_id AS branchId, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(tl.minutes), 0) FROM time_log tl WHERE tl.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND tl.task_id = t.id AND tl.ended_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_minutes FROM task t LEFT JOIN version_task vt ON vt.task_id = t.id AND vt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.req_id = #{reqId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY (t.board_column = 'done'), t.completed_at, t.id
SELECT version_id FROM version_task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT vt.task_id AS id, vt.version_id AS versionId, pv.name AS versionName FROM version_task vt LEFT JOIN project_version pv ON pv.id = vt.version_id AND pv.workspace_id = vt.workspace_id WHERE vt.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND vt.task_id IN #{taskId}
